accessGroups.title: Access groups
accessGroups.subtitle: IP/Basic Auth rules reach HAProxy only when a group is attached to a specific proxy host (hostname). Creating a group alone does not block anything yet.
accessGroups.calloutBody:
A saved access group does nothing until you open Proxy hosts → your domain → Access control → select groups → Save.

The HPM UI is served through the panel backend without those ACLs by default. To restrict the panel URL itself, create a proxy host for that hostname (upstream = your API/panel), enable HTTPS, and attach the group.

Behind Cloudflare or another proxy HAProxy sees the proxy IP, not the browser — adjust allowlists or rely on Basic Auth.
accessGroups.noClustersHint: Create a cluster under {{clusters}}, then define groups here.
accessGroups.emptyHint: Create a group with IP allowlist and/or users. Default behaviour stays open until you attach a group to a proxy host.
accessGroups.deleteDesc: {{name}} will be removed. Proxy hosts using it will become open (group detached).
accessGroups.modalDesc: Provide at least one allowed IP/CIDR line or one Basic Auth user with password.
accessGroups.ipHint: HAProxy `src` ACL: IPv4, IPv6, or CIDR. Requests from other IPs get HTTP 403.
accessGroups.authHint: Usernames: letters, digits, underscore. Combined with IP list: client must match IP and authenticate.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Export the full database snapshot to a JSON file or import a previous snapshot. Encrypted blobs are kept encrypted; the same ENCRYPTION_KEY must be used on the destination instance.
backup.exportDesc: Downloads a JSON file with all data: organizations, users, clusters, proxy hosts, certificates, access groups, error pages and HAProxy entities.
backup.importDesc: Replaces the entire database with data from the backup file. The current state is wiped. Use only on an empty or expendable instance.
backup.confirmBody: All current data will be erased and replaced with the backup. This is irreversible.
backup.invalidFile: File is not a valid HPM backup.

help.title: About HPM
help.lead: HPM (HAProxy Packet Manager) is a control plane for multiple HAProxy nodes: certificates, rendered configs, and proxy routing similar to Nginx Proxy Manager but for HAProxy only.

cluster.def: Logical group of HAProxy nodes that share one rendered configuration.

proxyHost.def: A hostname (or TCP stream) rule mapping clients to one upstream address and port.

certificate.def: TLS material used on :443; issued via ACME or uploaded PEM.

dns.def: Integration such as Cloudflare used for DNS-01 ACME challenges.

health.def: Periodic HTTP probe of the upstream for HTTP(S) hosts (TCP/UDP streams are not HTTP-probed).
